# Optimize My Data

> Optimize My Data is an Authorized Zoho Partner based in India, helping businesses implement, customize, and support the Zoho suite — including Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, Zoho Inventory, Zoho ERP, and Zoho One. Services include consulting, implementation, data migration (including from Tally), integration, training, and ongoing support.

Optimize My Data works with businesses across multiple industries, including EPC/solar, travel & tourism, automobile dealerships, food & beverage/restaurants, manufacturing, healthcare, retail & e-commerce, education, professional services, and non-profits.

## How implementation works

Discover current processes, design the Zoho architecture, implement and integrate apps, train users, then optimize workflows and reporting. A small CRM rollout can take a few weeks; a company-wide implementation can take several months.

## Paid consultation

A 45-60 minute one-to-one Zoho consultation via Zoho Meeting costs ₹1,250 plus taxes and includes a BRD-based requirement summary. Book at https://www.optimizemydata.com/consultation
